name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme that provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families with cultivable land.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers' Welfare
benefits: Eligible farmer families receive ₹6,000 per year.
The annual benefit is paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 every four months.
The benefit is transferred directly to the bank account of eligible beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

rules.description: Applicant must belong to a landholding farmer family with cultivable land held in the family's name.

exclusion_rules.description: Institutional land holders are excluded from PM-KISAN benefits.
Former and present holders of constitutional posts are excluded.
Specified former or present Ministers, Members of Parliament, Members of Legislative Assemblies or Councils, Mayors and District Panchayat Chairpersons are excluded.

Serving or retired specified government officers and employees, PSE employees, autonomous institution employees and regular local-body employees are excluded, except eligible MTS, Class IV or Group D employees.
Superannuated or retired pensioners receiving monthly pension of ₹10,000 or more are excluded, subject to the specified MTS, Class IV and Group D exception.
Persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded.
Registered and practicing doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects are excluded.
For new beneficiaries, landholding farmer families that are Non-Resident Indians are excluded.

documents.description: Aadhaar is used for identity and authentication.
Documents establishing the cultivable landholding are required.
Bank account details are required for receiving the benefit through DBT.

tutorial_steps.title: Open the PM-KISAN portal
tutorial_steps.tips: Use the official Government of India portal.

tutorial_steps.title: Start New Farmer Registration
tutorial_steps.description: Select the New Farmer Registration option.

tutorial_steps.title: Authenticate Aadhaar
tutorial_steps.description: Enter the required Aadhaar and mobile details and complete OTP-based Aadhaar authentication.

tutorial_steps.title: Enter farmer details
tutorial_steps.description: Fill in the required farmer and landholding information.

tutorial_steps.title: Provide required documents
tutorial_steps.description: Provide or upload the mandatory documents requested during registration.

tutorial_steps.title: Submit registration
tutorial_steps.description: Review the entered information and submit the registration.

tutorial_steps.title: Check application status
tutorial_steps.description: Use the PM-KISAN status facilities to check registration or beneficiary status.

profile_fields.description: Whether the applicant belongs to a farmer family holding cultivable land in its name.
Whether the landholder is an institutional land holder.
Monthly pension amount for determining the specified pension exclusion.
Whether the applicant paid income tax in the last assessment year.
Whether the applicant is a Non-Resident Indian.
Whether the applicant is a former or present holder of a constitutional post.
Whether the applicant falls within the specified political-office exclusion.
Whether the applicant falls within the specified government-employment exclusion.
Whether the applicant is a registered and practicing professional covered by the PM-KISAN exclusion.
